title: clove dependency tree envelope
description: The `clove dep tree <id>` response (nested form). `data` is a recursive node.

repeat_ref.description: This node's subtree is rendered elsewhere in the tree and is elided here. Optional: the engine and the MCP `clove_dep_tree` tool emit it, the CLI renderer does not.

_meta.description: Envelope metadata. `warnings` is the only key this response carries; `additionalProperties` is false so a new key has to be described here rather than shipping invisible to a client generated from this schema.
